name: dinar-makeup-chatbot
description: - to start the app you need to authenticate using vertex ai - vertex ai doesnt use api-key instead its using Service Accounts using gcloud CLI & Application Default Credentials (ADC) - to authenticate you need to install gcloud | docs : https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/install - after install gcloud run 'gcloud init' and setup your account with same GCP account with VERTEX AI enable - you can configure vertex ai with RAG or other method to make the LLM learn if you have spesific data - run 'gcloud auth application-default login' to initiate 'gcloud init' - lastly you can run the app by using 'yarn run dev'
author: Raie Aswajjillah
